categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two business segments: polyether polyols (PPG) and polyamide resins. The polyether segment includes polyether polyols, polymer polyols (POP), CASE-use polyethers, and amino-terminated polyethers. The polyamide segment includes nylon 66, long-chain nylon (bio-based), transparent nylon, and high-temperature nylon products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core technologies for high-content polyols (up to 50% solid content) with low viscosity, water-resistant properties, ultra-low VOC (residual monomer concentration below 2ppm), and high whiteness. Production utilizes continuous polymerization methods rather than traditional batch processes, enabling improved efficiency, reduced waste, and better product stability. The company also employs energy-saving technologies including liquid nitrogen cooling circulation systems and vacuum pump cooling water recycling.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves diverse downstream industries including furniture manufacturers (Mengsanhe, Xilinmen, Jinnuosi, Gu Jia), footwear brands (Li Ning, Anta, Hongxing Erke, Nike, Adidas), automotive suppliers (Yutong, Benz, Beifang Futian), waterproofing material companies (Oriental Yuhong, Beixin Waterproof), adhesive manufacturers (Huibei Huitian, Shanghai Kangda), and wind energy blade manufacturers (Shanghai Huibo, Sichuan Dongshu).
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Shandong Province, China, with headquarters in Zibo, Qingzhou District. It has established a subsidiary in Shanghai (Longhua Shanghai Polymer Materials Co., Ltd.) and maintains significant export markets in Southeast Asia, South Asia, and Eastern Europe. Domestic customers account for 84.44% of revenue while international customers represent 13.58%.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the chemical supply chain. It sources raw materials (propylene oxide, styrene, acrylonitrile, ethylene oxide) from upstream petrochemical suppliers and sells finished polyether and polyamide products to downstream manufacturers in furniture, footwear, automotive, and construction industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes product innovation and process optimization with R&D investments of 174.6 million yuan (3.10% of revenue). Key initiatives include developing high-performance polyethers for wind energy applications, improving polyol formulations for reduced yellowing, creating water-based polyurethane systems, developing specialty polyamides (transparent, high-temperature, long-chain bio-based), and advancing manufacturing efficiency through automation and energy conservation.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of polyether and polyamide products to end-manufacturers and distributors. It employs a 'cash before delivery' sales model for most customers, with selective credit terms for high-quality, long-term partners. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of products, typically upon delivery or pickup.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic polyether manufacturer with production capacity of 97 million tons annually and ranks among China's top polyether producers. It competes with other major polyether manufacturers through superior product quality, technical innovation, and cost efficiency. The company holds a significant market share in specialty polyethers (POP, CASE-use) where technical barriers are higher.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company generated revenue of 5.62 billion yuan in 2024 (12.01% growth from 5.02 billion in 2023) with net profit of 171.4 million yuan (down 30.90% from 248.0 million in 2023). Total assets reached 3.23 billion yuan (up 22.19% from 2.65 billion). The company shows strong asset growth driven by capacity expansion projects, though profitability declined due to lower product margins from market competition.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through advanced polyether technology offering high solid content with low viscosity, water resistance, and ultra-low VOC emissions that meet stringent environmental standards. Its proprietary POP (polymer polyol) technology provides superior performance characteristics. The company emphasizes customized solutions, reliable supply, consistent product quality, and technical support to major industrial customers, positioning itself as a preferred supplier for high-performance applications.
